items.title: Diploma of Community Services (Case Management)
items.description: The course will prepare to confidently handle multiple responsibilities, including implementing service programs and coordinating referral processes.

items.markdown:
The CHC52025 Diploma of Community Services is `a nationally recognized qualification (AQF Level 5) that prepares you for roles like case manager, support facilitator, or care team leader` . The course generally takes 12 to 24 months to complete and requires 100 to 400 hours of mandatory industry work placement.[](https://ihna.edu.au/courses/diploma-community-services-case-management-int/) [[1]](https://ihna.edu.au/courses/diploma-community-services-case-management-int/)[[2]](https://allied.edu.au/courses/diploma-of-community-services)[[3]](https://cac.edu.au/diploma-of-community-services-case-management/)[[4]](https://www.riverdaleinstitute.edu.au/diploma-of-community-services.php)[[5]](https://alg.edu.au/course/diploma-of-community-services/)[[6]](https://www.rmit.edu.au/study-with-us/levels-of-study/vocational-study/diplomas/diploma-of-community-services-c5450)[[7]](https://www.etea.edu.au/chc52021-diploma-of-community-services/)

Key course details and local Melbourne providers include:

- **RMIT University:** Offers an 18-month plan (C5450) or a fast-tracked 12-month plan (C5450C) at the Melbourne City campus, requiring 100 hours of work placement and 6 months of prior work experience.[](https://www.rmit.edu.au/study-with-us/levels-of-study/vocational-study/diplomas/diploma-of-community-services-c5450) [[1]](https://www.rmit.edu.au/study-with-us/levels-of-study/vocational-study/diplomas/diploma-of-community-services-c5450)
- **Melbourne Polytechnic:** Delivers a two-year full-time course focusing on trauma-informed practice, advocacy, and case management.[](https://www.melbournepolytechnic.edu.au/study/diploma/community-services/) [[1]](https://www.melbournepolytechnic.edu.au/study/diploma/community-services/)
- **Academia:** Offers a 78-week (approx. 18-month) program at their Melbourne CBD campus that includes up to 6 months of work placement.[](https://www.academia21.com/school/diploma-of-community-services) [[1]](https://www.academia21.com/school/diploma-of-community-services)
- **Allied Institute:** Located on Collins Street in the Melbourne CBD, this 78-week course features 200 hours of professional experience placement.[](https://ihna.edu.au/courses/diploma-community-services-case-management-int/) [[1]](https://ihna.edu.au/courses/diploma-community-services-case-management-int/)[[2]](https://allied.edu.au/courses/diploma-of-community-services)

To apply or compare fees and start dates, you can visit the [RMIT University Diploma of Community Services](https://www.rmit.edu.au/study-with-us/levels-of-study/vocational-study/diplomas/diploma-of-community-services-c5450) or explore the [Melbourne Polytechnic Diploma of Community Services](https://www.melbournepolytechnic.edu.au/study/diploma/community-services/) for detailed campus and enrollment information.[[1]](https://www.riverdaleinstitute.edu.au/diploma-of-community-services.php)[[2]](https://cac.edu.au/diploma-of-community-services-case-management/)[[3]](https://alg.edu.au/course/diploma-of-community-services/)
